test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Neglected for a long time__, the ancient monument needs immediate restoration.

options.text: Having neglect for a long time

solution:
The correct answer is **'****No improvement required'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• Let's take a look at the sentence, the word 'neglected' expresses that somebody/something to fail to take care of somebody/something.
 
• The expression 'a long time' will be used with the preposition 'for' because as a preposition it is used to express 'over a span of (time or distance)'.
 
• Thus, the given sentence is correct and required no improvement.

Correct sentence:__ *__**Neglected for a long time**__, the ancient monument needs immediate restoration.*
